_doc: Factory motion-phase catalog. A 'phase' is a coarse behavioral grouping over the canonical motion_tag set (see registers.commands TrainingItem.default_motion_tag). Reward terms in the canvas Rewards node may declare `applies_to: [phase_id...]` to scope themselves to one or more phases; reward terms with `applies_to == []` (or missing) apply to every phase ('Unconditional'). The compile path translates the phase_id list into a runtime mask keyed off env._active_task_idx -> task_item.motion_tag -> phase_id. User-side overlay lives at ~/UnitPort/registers/motion_phases_custom.json and is merged on load via registers.motion_phases.merge_user_extensions. Polarity_required drives the Coverage Badge: 'negative' phases without any negative reward go red; 'both' phases without one polarity go yellow; 'any' is informational only.

phases.description_default: Robot stationary — requires negative reward to prevent idle limb-flailing.
Steady-speed locomotion — needs velocity tracking (+) and action smoothing (-).
High-speed or aerial motion — encourages gait + air time, penalizes excessive contact force.
